name: API Orchestrator - Mirror
description: Map an external API response to a filterable, sortable local listing using dot-notation field mapping and an SDC display.
project_description: API Orchestrator - Mirror maps external API responses to a local, filterable display. An api_mirror config entity references an API Orchestrator endpoint, a dot-notation root path to the items array, and field/filter mappings. Data is fetched live from the API on each page load (JsonPathResolver flattens/extracts paths; MirrorQueryService applies filtering, sorting and pagination in PHP) and rendered via an SDC listing component with AJAX. Requires api_orchestrator. Lifecycle: experimental. Part of the API Orchestrator project.
